reason: The independently sourced sentence defines which smooth curves on an open interval are geodesics. Its opening smooth-curve clause can be the domain of discourse, rather than a smoothness conjunct demanded of a predicate on arbitrary functions. The packaged root is an equation-only predicate on arbitrary real-parameter curves and arbitrary sets. Its HasGeodesicEquationAt includes first and second chart derivatives and the Christoffel ODE, but does not separately require the manifold-valued curve to remain in its centered chart source locally. Therefore omission of a literal smoothness binder is not sufficient by itself to conclude mismatch against the source evaluated on smooth interval-domain curves. Conversely, if this task expects the entire definition as a classifier on arbitrary curves, the equation-only root appears broader than the target, and one must check whether chart junk extension permits discontinuous examples. Current material does not settle the evaluation-domain decision or furnish a checked separating example.
